verdict.rationale: Green and Spiegel is an immigration law firm offering legal consultation and visa services, not a software product, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any software, app or API where telemetry settings could exist; the only site-related items are a newsletter signup and failed llms.txt/OpenAPI probes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
